name: Joah
bio: Joah son of Asaph, the recorder, along with Eliakim son of Hilkiah and Shebna the scribe, went out to meet Sennacherib's officers when they came against Jerusalem and heard Rabshakeh's mocking, threatening speech. He returned to Hezekiah with his clothes torn, reporting what had been said (2 Kings 18:18-37).
